caption: A handful of gummy bears is scattered on a hot baking tray, and they soften, slump and spread into flat glossy blobs.

sa.check: Gummy bears are scattered on a baking tray.
The bears spread into flat glossy blobs.
Each bear loses its shape from the bottom up.
The bears keep their own colours.
The softening comes first and the spreading follows.

pc.expect: Each bear loses its ears, arms and face from the bottom upward and becomes a wider, lower blob.
pc.fail: A bear keeps its sharp ears and face while flat and glossy; or a bear shrinks upward into a taller narrower shape; or a bear's features sharpen as it melts; or a bear turns into another figure.

pc.expect: The slumping only advances and the blobs do not firm up again on the hot tray.
pc.fail: A blob draws back up into a standing bear; or a blob's edges pull inward and it stands taller; or the bears set firm and matt again on the hot tray; or a bear alternates between standing and slumped.

pc.expect: Each bear sinks downward onto the tray and its blob spreads outward and downhill.
pc.fail: A bear rises off the tray; or a blob climbs the tray's rim and stays; or a blob spreads uphill on a tilted tray; or melted gummy lifts off the tray.

pc.expect: The gummy softens into a thick glossy liquid that flows slowly and keeps a rounded edge.
pc.fail: A blob runs as thin as water; or a bear shatters dry; or a blob stands as a rigid dome with sharp edges; or a bear stretches into a thread that snaps back like elastic.

pc.expect: The bears on the tray are the bears that were scattered; none appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A bear vanishes; or a new bear appears on the tray; or a blob grows with nothing added; or a blob passes through the tray.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Each blob keeps its bear's colour, and the tray and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: A blob is a different colour from its bear; or the tray changes colour; or items around the tray rearrange.
